_legal_caveat: These are the regulation's own published inputs, transcribed verbatim from EUR-Lex with the exact article/annex and text span named per figure. reference_value.meaning: Article 4(2)'s reference value that every period's limit is a percentage reduction of. Recital 23 states this is the fleet average GHG intensity of the energy used on board by ships in 2020, per Regulation (EU) 2015/757 (MRV) data.

article_23_2_multiplier.formula: 1 + (n - 1) / 10, n = the number of consecutive reporting periods a company is subject to a FuelEU penalty for that ship, n >= 2 (n = 1: multiplier = 1, no surcharge)

source.quote: If a ship has a compliance deficit for two consecutive reporting periods or more, that amount shall be multiplied by 1 + (n − 1)/10, where n is the number of consecutive reporting periods for which the company is subject to a FuelEU penalty for that ship.
